checks.detail: Enter produced NO outbound event and NO app traffic at all (uid bytes rx+0 tx+0) in 180s of polling, so the quiet typing window proves nothing. The app did leave edit mode. Two independent measurements agree here -- the packet capture and the kernel's per-uid accounting -- so the search did not run; leaving edit mode only means Enter was consumed, not that a query was issued. Chase the UI interaction (does `input keyevent 66` commit this Compose field after a long idle?), not the capture. -- owned by LW-M4-11
